Levi Strauss & Co. manages its business according to three reportable segments—Americas, Europe, and Asia—which collectively comprise the Levi's Brands business, including the Levi's®, Levi Strauss Signature™ and Denizen® brands [1][3][5][6][7]. Additionally, the Beyond Yoga® business is managed separately and does not meet the quantitative thresholds for reportable segments but is presented separately for transparency [1][3][5][6][7].

For the year ended November 30, 2025, segment net revenues were: Americas $3,297.0 million, Europe $1,699.3 million, and Asia $1,134.4 million, totaling $6,130.7 million for Levi's Brands, with Beyond Yoga® adding $151.3 million for total net revenues of $6,282.0 million [1]. Segment operating income was Americas $722.9 million (21.9% of net revenues), Europe $366.7 million (21.6% of net revenues), and Asia $148.6 million (13.1% of net revenues), for total Levi's Brands operating income of $1,238.2 million (20.2% of net revenues) [1][15]. Beyond Yoga® reported an operating loss of $(13.6) million [1][15]. Compared to the prior year, Americas operating income grew 3.7%, Europe grew 14.7%, and Asia grew 10.2%, while Beyond Yoga®'s loss improved by 32.0% [15].
